source.notes: Horizon model: lola-terrain (real skyline from the LOLA DEMs out to 200 km, target accuracy 0.1 deg). Metric uncertainties (where given) combine the landing-position spread and the skyline accuracy (analysis/uncertainty.py). Sun/Earth az/el cross-checked against JPL Horizons: max 0.00003 deg (docs/validation/horizons.md).
